changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE knowledge.workflow ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, description TEXT, engine TEXT NOT NULL, external_ref TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', meta JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT ck_workflow_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'draft', 'disabled')) ); CREATE INDEX ix_workflow_engine ON knowledge.workflow (engine);

changeSet.author: javakishore-veleti
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE knowledge.knowledge_source ADD COLUMN workflow_id UUID REFERENCES knowledge.workflow(id);
